description: This file contains configuration directives and settings specific to building and tuning for the PowerPC 603e processor in a Yocto/OE build environment. It sets compiler flags, optimizer options, and architecture-specific features for the build system.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: A utility method used to check if a particular feature or string exists within a variable or list. In this context, it checks if 'ppc603e' is part of 'TUNE_FEATURES'.
